blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
At senior level, VAT is not just a compliance exercise — it is a working capital engine. Between the day VAT is charged on a sale and the day it is settled with the tax office, the company is holding the government's money. Between the day VAT is paid on a purchase and the day the refund arrives, the government is holding the company's money. The gap is measured in weeks, and at scale, it matters.

What a senior tax leader cares about is the shape of this flow. Are refunds received on time? Are overpayments recovered quickly? Are filing cycles optimised so that cash sits in the right place for as long as legally permitted? Each of these small operational questions has a measurable cash impact that compounds across the year.

It is the invisibility of VAT cash flows that makes them easy to neglect — and the neglect, at scale, is expensive. Senior leaders who watch VAT as a cash engine quietly outperform those who treat it as paperwork.

items.q: According to the text, what is VAT at senior level?
items.why: "VAT is not just a compliance exercise — it is a working capital engine."

items.q: Between charging VAT on a sale and settling it with the tax office, who is holding whose money?
options: The government is holding the company's money
The company is holding the government's money
The customer is holding the company's money
No one is holding anything until year-end
items.why: "the company is holding the government's money" nesse intervalo — daí o efeito de caixa.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which statement?
options: The timing of refunds has a measurable cash impact.
VAT is essentially paperwork with no strategic value.
Small operational questions can compound across the year.
Cash should sit in the right place for as long as legally permitted.
items.why: Inferência: o texto inteiro argumenta que tratar o IVA como papelada é justamente o erro que custa caro.

items.q: What does the phrase "the neglect, at scale, is expensive" most strongly suggest?
options: Only small firms can afford to ignore VAT
The cost of inattention grows with transaction volume
VAT penalties are fixed regardless of size
Neglect is cheaper than active management
items.why: Inferência: "at scale" indica que o custo da desatenção cresce à medida que o volume aumenta.

items.q: Why, according to the text, are VAT cash flows easy to neglect?
options: Because they never affect working capital
items.why: "It is the invisibility of VAT cash flows that makes them easy to neglect."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver apresentando a análise à liderança. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Thanks. I'll keep this short, because the number speaks for itself. What I've been looking at is not our tax position — that's clean — but the timing of our VAT cash.

Here's the finding. Over the last four quarters, we overpaid VAT in three of them, and in each case the refund sat with the tax office far longer than it needed to. We weren't wrong on a single filing. We simply weren't chasing what was already ours.

What that means, in plain terms, is that a meaningful amount of cash — cash we're entitled to — has been parked with the government instead of working on our balance sheet. And because it's a refund, not a saving, there's no cost to recovering it. It's ours the moment we ask for it properly.

So my proposal isn't a restructuring or a new system. It's a discipline. We accelerate the refund claims on the overpaid quarters, we tighten the filing cycle so this doesn't recur, and we treat VAT recovery as a monthly cash exercise rather than a quarterly formality. Done quietly, this frees the money without changing a single trade.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Oliver's analysis actually about?
options: The timing of the company's VAT cash
A restructuring of the finance team
A dispute with the tax office over filings
items.why: "not our tax position — that's clean — but the timing of our VAT cash."

items.q: What did Oliver find about the last four quarters?
options: The company underpaid VAT in three of them
The company overpaid VAT in three of them and refunds sat too long
items.why: "we overpaid VAT in three of them, and in each case the refund sat with the tax office far longer than it needed to."

items.q: When Oliver says "there's no cost to recovering it," he means that…
options: the recovery requires expensive legal advice
reclaiming the refund does not reduce profit — it is money already owed to the company
the tax office charges a fee to release the refund
the company must give up a tax saving in exchange
items.why: Inferência: por ser reembolso (dinheiro já da empresa) e não economia, recuperá-lo não tem contrapartida.

items.q: What is the nature of Oliver's proposal?
options: A new IT system for tax filing
A full restructuring of the trading desk
A discipline: faster refund claims and monthly VAT recovery
A one-off write-off of the overpaid amounts
items.why: "my proposal isn't a restructuring or a new system. It's a discipline."

items.q: How would you best describe Oliver's overall message?
options: The company has been breaking the rules and must correct course
The cash is already the company's; it just needs to be claimed with discipline
The tax office has been withholding money unfairly
The finding is minor and not worth acting on
items.why: Inferência: nenhuma declaração estava errada — a questão é reclamar disciplinadamente o que já é da empresa.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Treated well, VAT becomes a genuine cash engine." A cash engine is…
options: a mechanism that generates or frees up cash
a legal penalty for late payment
items.why: Cash engine = motor de caixa: um mecanismo que gera ou libera dinheiro.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There is a ___ of several weeks between paying VAT on a purchase and receiving the refund."
items.why: Gap = lacuna, o intervalo de tempo entre o pagamento e o reembolso.

items.q: "The desk had an overpayment of VAT in three quarters." An overpayment is…
options: an amount paid above what was actually due
a discount applied to the tax bill
items.why: Overpayment = pagamento a maior: valor pago acima do devido.

items.q: Choose the correct term: "By tightening the ___, cash sits in the right place for as long as legally permitted."
items.why: Filing cycle = ciclo de declaração; ajustá-lo controla quando o caixa se move.

items.q: "Leaders who manage VAT strategically quietly outperform their peers." To outperform means to…
items.why: To outperform = superar, entregar resultado melhor que os demais.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões de finanças e tributos. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The CFO still has to sign off on the accelerated refund claims." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "Freeing this cash could genuinely move the needle on working capital." This means it would…
items.why: Move the needle = mexer o ponteiro, produzir uma diferença perceptível.

items.q: "We agreed the discipline last quarter but never followed through." They…
options: failed to carry it through to completion
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado; "never followed through" = não levaram adiante.

items.q: "Two directors pushed back on chasing the refunds so aggressively." They…
options: resisted or objected to the idea
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar — sem necessariamente rejeitar de vez.

items.q: "Let's roll out the monthly recovery routine across every jurisdiction." To roll out means to…
options: implement in stages across the board
items.why: Roll out = implementar de forma progressiva e ampla.
